statusLine.command: input=$(cat); dir=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.workspace.current_dir'); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name // empty'); ctx_used=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); ctx_rem=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.remaining_percentage // empty'); cost=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.cost.total_cost_usd // 0'); rl_5h=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.five_hour.used_percentage // empty'); rl_7d=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.rate_limits.seven_day.used_percentage // empty'); git_br=$(cd "$dir" 2>/dev/null && GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 git symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null || GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 git describe --tags --exact-match 2>/dev/null || GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 git rev-parse --short HEAD 2>/dev/null); git_dirt=$(cd "$dir" 2>/dev/null && GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 git diff --quiet 2>/dev/null; if [ $? -eq 1 ]; then echo '±'; fi); out="$(printf '\033[36m')$dir$(printf '\033[0m')"; [ -n "$git_br" ] && out="$out $(printf '\033[34m')git:$(printf '\033[31m')($git_br$(printf '\033[34m'))$(printf '\033[0m')$(printf '\033[33m')$git_dirt$(printf '\033[0m')"; [ -n "$model" ] && out="$out $(printf '\033[90m')[$model]$(printf '\033[0m')"; rl_out=""; [ -n "$rl_5h" ] && [ "$rl_5h" != "null" ] && rl_out="5h:${rl_5h}%"; [ -n "$rl_7d" ] && [ "$rl_7d" != "null" ] && rl_out="${rl_out:+$rl_out|}7d:${rl_7d}%"; [ -n "$rl_out" ] && out="$out $(printf '\033[90m')[$rl_out]$(printf '\033[0m')"; [ -n "$ctx_used" ] && [ "$ctx_used" != "null" ] && out="$out $(printf '\033[90m')[${ctx_used}%]$(printf '\033[0m')" || ([ -n "$ctx_rem" ] && [ "$ctx_rem" != "null" ] && out="$out $(printf '\033[90m')[${ctx_rem}%↑]$(printf '\033[0m')"); [ "$cost" != "0" ] && out="$out $(printf '\033[90m')[$cost]$(printf '\033[0m')"; echo "$out"
